scope: Pressure result display only. Aerodynamic and structural numerical solvers, loads and convergence admission are unchanged.
default: Full actual range, signed square-root colour contrast; zero green, negative limit blue, positive limit red. The colour-bar gradient uses exactly the same mapping.
manual_range: Signed limits include zero; same physical limits retained on switching Cp/Pa. Saturated panels are hatched and counted. True extrema, probes and CSV are not clipped.
Cp_mesh_check: Reports each existing solved mesh min/max Cp and relative change of extrema on the last refinement in both directions. The 10% flag is a display sensitivity indicator, not a local convergence acceptance test or numerical admission criterion.

representative_browser_case.interpretation: The negative extreme is strongly span-mesh-sensitive; no claim of a converged local tip-pressure peak is made.
browser_checks: Cp to Pa limits and counts preserved
mobile 390 x 844: pressure canvas 361 x 432 pixels
